description: Select and execute an open-loop planar force pulse that moves a MuJoCo puck into a target region.
prerequisites: MuJoCo 3.13 or a compatible 3.x version is installed.
The packaged planar push MJCF is used without parameter changes.
The target and puck names exist in the model.
procedure: Load a fresh MuJoCo model for every candidate.
Read the puck and target positions from MuJoCo data.
Apply each candidate force at the puck center of mass and settle.
Measure completion, final error, path, time, contacts, bounds, and stability.
Select completion first and objective score second.
Execute the selected plan in a separate fresh rollout and record the result.
known_limits: Validated only for the packaged deterministic planar model.
Open-loop force is not robust to unknown mass, friction, or initial pose.
Not a physical robot controller and not approved for hardware.
Rotation and obstacle avoidance are not yet implemented.
